shortDescription: UPSSSC Pharmacist (Ayurvedic) Advt 01-Exam/2024 Eligibility Result out. 2,678 candidates shortlisted for Mains against 1,002 posts based on PET-2023 scores.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Eligibility Result for Pharmacist (Ayurvedic) Examination under Advt. No. 01-Exam/2024 for 1,002 vacancies.

A total of 2,678 candidates have been shortlisted for the Mains written examination on the basis of PET-2023 normalised scores. Candidates with zero or negative actual/normalised PET scores were not shortlisted.

Important

  • This is an eligibility / shortlisting result, not the final selection list
  • Shortlisted candidates must appear in the Mains exam when scheduled
  • Download notices only from upsssc.gov.in

Keep checking the commission website for Mains exam date, admit card and further instructions.
